item.title: The $75,000 Bond and Truckers Left Holding The Bag
item.description: Nearly 88,000 trucking companies closed in 2023. Fraud losses topped $455 million in 2024. Carriers filing claims against $75,000 surety bonds are discovering that the pot's already been split 50 ways. As the Supreme Court prepares to rule on whether brokers can be held liable for hiring bad carriers, it's time to ask: who really bears the risk in freight, and is the system rigged against the people actually moving the loads?
